item.title: San Diego cardrooms pushback against California's new Blackjack ban
item.description: California cardrooms could face a major hit come April 1, as new regulations will bar them from offering blackjack-style games, which could result in job losses and decreased revenue for local communities.

item.title: San Diego woman who bought Porsche and $2.9M home with stolen funds sentenced to prison
item.description: A woman from the Point Loma neighborhood of San Diego will spend time behind bars after she admitted embezzling and laundering millions of dollars from her employer.

item.title: MTS announces schedule changes for Presidents Day
item.description: San Diego Metropolitan Transit System will operate on a reduced schedule on Presidents Day, with most bus and Trolley routes running on a Saturday schedule, while the Vintage Trolley will operate on the Silver Line throughout the day.

item.title: Recent San Diego parking funds used to fix over 3,500 neighborhood repairs
item.description: The City of San Diego has completed over 3,500 neighborhood repairs over the past three months, funded by allocated parking meter revenue, including 1,230 streetlights and 2,288 potholes in Downtown, Mid-City, Pacific Beach and Uptown.

item.title: San Diego Police warn about 'bank jugging' criminals during Lunar New Year
item.description: Police are warning that criminals may take advantage of the increase in cash transactions tied to the Lunar New Year holiday, and are urging residents to remain vigilant when withdrawing money.

item.title: Authorities investigate fatal three-vehicle crash in East County
item.description: A fatal three-vehicle crash in La Presa Friday night left one person dead and sent others to the hospital, and the California Highway Patrol is investigating the incident.

item.title: Crews knock down attic fire at popular Chula Vista taqueria
item.description: The Chula Vista Fire Department responded to a commercial fire at Chula Tacos on Saturday night, resulting in one person being taken to the hospital with unknown injuries.

item.title: City prepares for multi-day storm, urges residents to prepare
item.description: The City of San Diego is taking steps to prepare for heavy rain expected to move into the region, including cleaning drains and inlets, monitoring river levels, and providing sandbags to residents in limited quantities.
